about.en: Seerah (P29, C4.7): 8 to 10 short lessons on the Prophet's life (his birth and youth, the trustworthy, the revelation, the Hijra, Madinah, his kindness and teaching), our own text drafted by or with a Hanafi scholar, each citing its classical source by reference only (Ibn Hisham's Sirah; no edition's text, no hadith text in 2027). Read steps only, no question steps; a line map and no other picture; narration recorded by native speakers. No lessons yet: none is written by a tool or a model.
